subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Identificar situações da vida cotidiana nas quais seja necessário fazer escolhas levando-se em conta os riscos probabilísticos (usar este ou aquele método contraceptivo, optar por um tratamento médico em detrimento de outro etc.).

components.description_pt: Identificar situações cotidianas que requerem avaliar opções baseadas em risco probabilístico
components.description_en: Identify everyday situations that require evaluating options based on probabilistic risk
components.cc_component_description: Recognize and explain the concepts of independence and conditional probability in everyday situations

components.description_pt: Interpretar informações de probabilidade associadas a escolhas reais como opções contraceptivas ou médicas
components.description_en: Interpret probability information associated with real-life choices such as contraceptive or medical options
components.cc_component_description: Analyze and evaluate decisions in real world contexts using probability concepts

components.description_pt: Comparar riscos probabilísticos de diferentes escolhas para apoiar tomada de decisão informada
components.description_en: Compare probabilistic risks of different choices to support informed decision-making
components.cc_component_description: Weigh the possible outcomes of a decision by assigning probabilities to payoff values and finding expected values.

cc_matches.description: Recognize and explain the concepts of conditional probability and independence in everyday language and everyday situations. *For example, compare the chance of having lung cancer if you are a smoker with the chance of being a smoker if you have lung cancer.*
(+) Analyze decisions and strategies using probability concepts (e.g., product testing, medical testing, pulling a hockey goalie at the end of a game).
(+) Weigh the possible outcomes of a decision by assigning probabilities to payoff values and finding expected values.
